rebalance_owner_only_documented.meaning: rebalanceFunds is documented (interface and docstring) as callable only by owner

current_balance.meaning: vault DLF balance before the rebalanceFunds call

redemption_forced_to_custodian_path.meaning: large redemption submitted while on-chain liquidity was ample is forced into the slower custodian path because the buffer was drained to target just before inclusion
redemption_forced_to_custodian_path.checkpoint: after attacker's rebalanceFunds call, at redemption inclusion

assumptions: The attacker's rebalanceFunds call is unprivileged and not authorized by the owner.
The redemption is large enough that it would have been served from the on-chain buffer had the buffer not been drained to target.
The attacker's call is ordered before the redemption's inclusion in a block (mempool front-running).

unresolved.description: Report does not give numeric targetBalance or buffer amounts, so the magnitude of excess drained and the size threshold of 'large' redemptions cannot be bound numerically.

limitations: Impact is formalized as the conditional griefing scenario: forced routing to the custodian path despite ample on-chain liquidity at submission time; the report's 'potential' framing of the attacker call is preserved via assumptions rather than asserted as observed.
Only the owner-only access-control intent is used as I; the buffer-preservation and event-authority intents are handled in separate claim passes.
The forced-custodian-path outcome is represented as a grounded Boolean because the report states the qualitative condition without numeric operands.
